title: Marcos ‘perplexed’ by Pax Silica protests, says no data centers planned

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday said he was “perplexed” by the protests against United States-led Pax Silica initiative, saying there were no provisions in the agreement that warranted such opposition. In a press briefing here before heading back to Manila, Marcos stressed that the initiative did not include plans to build data centers in the Philippines. He said the project is an attempt to widen sources of technological commodities, and part of fhe Philippines’ efforts to take part in the artificial intelligence economy.
